feed_title: Sherpa Nest Dog Bed, Raised Rim, Zipped 30C Washable Cover, Five Sizes, XS 45 x 35cm to XL 90 x 70cm | PawLunova Sawrey
descriptionHtml:
Sherpa pile. A rim, not a wall. XS 45 × 35cm to XL 90 × 70cm.

Sawrey is a sherpa nest dog bed with a raised rim around the resting area, in five sizes from XS 45 × 35cm to XL 90 × 70cm. The zipped cover washes at 30°C.

Owners buy a rim thinking it is a wall. The dog treats it as a pillow. Watch where the chin lands when they finally go down.

Sawrey is built for the chin. The rim is raised rather than deep, so it works as a headrest and as a low way in.

What they get

  • Sherpa-pile lining: A textured surface for a dog who kneads before settling.
  • A raised rim: It surrounds the resting area and gives a chin somewhere to land.
  • Five listed sizes: XS 45 × 35cm, Medium 65 × 45cm, Large 70 × 55cm and XL 90 × 70cm, plus a Small.
  • A zipped cover: It removes and washes at 30°C.

Best for: Dogs who rest a head on the edge, and households wanting one bed shape across very differently sized dogs.

Why it is worth the money

XS is £49, Small £79, Medium £99, Large £139 and XL £169. The spread is the point. The same sherpa rim runs from 45 × 35cm up to 90 × 70cm. Sherpa is the warm option in our nest range rather than the firm one. Take the 100 nights before deciding it was too much.

The rim is a rim. A dog who wants to vanish entirely will do better with deep walls, and we would rather tell you that now than after it arrives.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
XS45 × 35
SmallNot listed
Medium65 × 45
Large70 × 55
XL90 × 70

Our Small has no published measurements, so ask us before choosing it. The rest are outside figures and the rim takes part of them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

How do I choose across five sizes?

Curled-up length plus 15 to 20cm, then read the table. Ask about the Small.

Will I be charged for delivery?

No, once the basket is over £40. Lead times are on the shipping page.

Can I pay in instalments?

Instalment choices are offered during checkout.

How high is the rim?

No height is published, and raised is the honest word rather than deep.

What about a stiff old dog who finds getting up hard?

A low rim is easier than a tall side, but ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes, at 30°C once unzipped, and bone dry before refitting.

What if it gets ignored?

The 100 nights exist for that, collection included.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Pick a size from XS to XL and give their chin a sherpa rim.
